context: Decide one of: (a) add benchbox/core/results/anonymization.py to SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES, (b) add a separate privacy-path list feeding the same auto-merge stop, or (c) record an explicit decision to exclude it. Whichever is chosen, leave an in-file comment stating the rationale so the next reader does not re-litigate, matching how the existing prefixes are annotated.
description: _project/scripts/auto_merge_soundness_paths.py SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES does not cover benchbox/core/results/anonymization.py. Consequence observed 2026-08-04: PR #1512 changed the public anonymizer, which changed every published byte and every public result_id for the whole corpus, and 'make pr-open' enabled auto-merge on it without owner review because the classifier did not rate the path soundness-critical. The classifier's recorded scope is benchmark CORRECTNESS - the comments describe it as what defines a 'correct' result (comparators, plan parsers, expected_results, rewrite-rule dispatch). Publication privacy and public identity are a different axis, so adding the anonymizer is a deliberate surface WIDENING, and the file's own comments record that widening is an owner decision made under the 'soundness-surface-widening' rationale rather than a mechanical edit. Hence this is filed as a decision, not a fix. Arguments for adding it: a bug there can leak private values or silently repartition public pseudonym identity, and neither failure raises. Argument against: it is a different risk axis than soundness and widening the list dilutes its meaning - a separate privacy-path list feeding the same auto-merge gate may be the better shape. Note the classifier is already self-protecting (it lists itself), so a PR editing it will not auto-merge. There is currently no test module for the classifier under tests/unit/scripts/.

preserves.behavior: The classifier stays self-protecting - it must keep listing itself and the release and auto-merge workflow files
pr.yml stays deliberately excluded per the recorded soundness-surface-widening decision

verifications.description: The anonymizer's auto-merge treatment is explicitly recorded either way
verifications.expected: Exits 0 once the file either lists the anonymizer or carries a comment naming it as a deliberate exclusion

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/scripts -q -k soundness
verifications.description: Classifier behaviour is covered by a test
verifications.expected: Write the test in w1 so this rung becomes runnable

work_units.evidence: Commit 32415ca888. DECIDED option (a): widen SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES rather than add a separate privacy list or record an exclusion. Joe chose this shape when the fork was put to him. Rationale: the list already carries non-soundness categories under their own labeled blocks - release.yml is present because it publishes to PyPI, and the self-protection block covers the gate machinery - and is_soundness_path's own docstring already reads 'needs review before auto-merge', which is broader than soundness. A separate list would have required widening the 1:1 CODEOWNERS pin and every any_soundness_path caller for no behavioural gain.
work_units.summary: Decide the shape - widen SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES, add a separate privacy list, or record an explicit exclusion

work_units.evidence: Commit 32415ca888.
